[[File:Team Electric Princess.png|thumb|250px|Electric Princess]] The '''Electric Princess''' team (Japanese: '''エレキプリンセス''' ''Electric Princess'') are minor characters who appeared in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. ==History== They first appeared in ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', as a group of girls who entered the [[Charjabug race]] with a {{p|Charjabug}} belonging to one of them. They raced against {{Ash}}, {{an|Sophocles}}, and {{an|Kiawe}}, who had entered with [[Sophocles's Charjabug]]; and {{TRT}}, who disguised {{MTR}} as a Charjabug. They managed to do very well during the race and went head to head with the Red Comet team and the Sophocles Lab team. However, during the last section, which involved an icy underground, the team's Charjabug slipped and nearly crashed into Sophocles's Charjabug. Ash jumped in the way and took the hit, causing their racing car to break. With this, the Electric Princess team was eliminated from the race, but they were still rewarded third place by default. One of the girls reappeared in ''[[SM119|A High-Speed Awakening!]]''. She was one of the competitors in the [[Vikavolt race]], using her evolved {{p|Vikavolt}}, but ended up losing. ==Pokémon== This listing is of the Electric Princess team's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{MissingInfo|1|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Electric Princess |pkmn=Vikavolt |stage1=Charjabug |type1=Bug |type2=Electric |img=Team Electric Princess Charjabug.png |img2=Vikavolt race Vikavolt.png |epnum=SM041 |epname=Mounting an Electrifying Charge! |vajp= |vaen=Simona Berman |desc={{p|Vikavolt}} is the Electric Princess team's only known Pokémon. It first appeared as a {{p|Charjabug}} in ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', where it competed in the [[Charjabug race]]. It managed to do very well during the race, managing to go head to head with the Red Comet team and the Sophocles Lab team. However, during the last section of the race, which involved an icy underground, Charjabug slipped and nearly crashed into Sophocles's own Charjabug. Ash jumped in the way and took the hit, causing their racing car to break. With this, the Electric Princess team was eliminated from the race, but they were still rewarded third place by default. It appeared again in ''[[SM119|A High-Speed Awakening!]]'' as a Vikavolt. It participated in the [[Vikavolt race]], but ended up losing.
